subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot onramp — Hillcrest Logistics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <james.park@hillcrest-logistics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot onramp — Hillcrest Logistics

James — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed onramp so we can get a 30-day pilot running next week. I put Ben and Sergio on copy to own commercial and technical setup respectively.

Key pain points we heard
- Manual claims triage is slow; 2–3 people are spending ~18 hours/week on triage and exception handling.
- Model drift on lookup-based rules leads to false positives and manual rework.
- Existing vendor latency spikes during month-end processing, causing SLA misses.

Pilot goals (30 days)
- Reduce manual triage time by 40% for the cargo exceptions workflow.
- Maintain precision >= 92% on the extraction/evidence classification task.
- P95 inference latency < 300ms for 4k-token payloads under expected pilot throughput.

Proposed pilot scope
- Workload: cargo exception triage (sample set from Nov logs) — ~10k records.
- Models: rwd-lift-7b-q4 (baseline) + quantized variant for latency testing.
- Success metrics: avg triage time reduction, precision/recall on labeled prompt set, and per-token cost estimate.
- Owners: Hillcrest product — James Park (primary), Redwood — Rachel (AE) / Ben (Solutions) / Sergio (SE).
- Timeline:
  - Week 0: NDA/MSA review + sandbox access (this week)
  - Week 1: Data ingest + prompt set handoff (you provide sanitized sample)
  - Week 2: Eval runs, prompt-tuning, observability dashboard live
  - Week 3: Acceptance testing on holdout set; cost/latency tuning
  - Week 4: Readout and roll/no-roll decision

Access & setup asks (what we need from you)
1) A sanitized sample of 2k–3k records (CSV) and data schema.
2) List of IP ranges for allowlist or the static public IPs you’ll use.
3) Procurement contact for MSA flow (cc them when ready).

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + eval matrix).

Next steps (my ask)
- Please confirm procurement contact and whether Hillcrest can share a sanitized sample by EOD Wed.
- If the timeline works, I’ll schedule a kickoff for Mon Dec 6 and open sandbox credentials.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: James Park <james.park@hillcrest-logistics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:02:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot onramp — Hillcrest Logistics

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from procurement and security: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@hillcrest-logistics.com (CC'd in a follow-up I will send). They’ll require the MSA + SOW and a short pricing note for the pilot.
- Security: we need a SOC 2 summary and an outline of data retention/segregation during the pilot (can we set 30-day retention and a toggle to purge test data?).
- Technical: we can provide a sanitized CSV by end of day Thursday. I’ll confirm whether we need IP allowlisting or a VPN egress address — procurement prefers allowlist.

I’ll loop in our Head of Product (Marta Li) in the follow-up if helpful. For kickoff, Dec 6 looks fine from my side if procurement is OK with the MSA timing.

Attached: sample email from procurement (they’ll formalize).

—
James Park
Senior Product Manager — Automation
Hillcrest Logistics
james.park@hillcrest-logistics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <james.park@hillcrest-logistics.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:45:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot onramp — Hillcrest Logistics

James — great to meet you (virtually). Quick answers below and next steps to unblock procurement/security: 

- SOC2 & security: attaching our SOC2-audit-summary.pdf (redacted). We can set pilot data retention to 30 days by default and provide a one-click purge at the end of the pilot. Full audit logs available on request.
- Sandbox access: I’ll provision a sandbox org and API key for Hillcrest. We support IP allowlisting — please send the outbound IP ranges and we’ll add them to the sandbox ACL.
- MSA / SOW: I’ve shared a DocuSign draft to https://www.docusign.com/MLA-HL-004 — procurement can e-sign; Ben will shepherd any redlines.

Technical notes for the SE team: Sergio — once James confirms sample delivery, can you prepare an ingest job and a default prompt set (we’ll include the prompt/eval matrix from pilot-charter-v1)? Estimate 24–48 hours to get sample ingested and dashboards live.

Next steps for James:
1) Confirm procurement contact (procurement@hillcrest-logistics.com).
2) Share sanitized CSV + schema by Thu EOD.
3) Provide IP ranges for allowlist.

I’ll open the sandbox today and send credentials in a separate note.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: SOC2-audit-summary.pdf

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: ownership & enablement for Hillcrest pilot (internal)

Marissa / Sergio — summarizing so we’re aligned:

- Commercial lead: Rachel (AE) / Ben (Solutions) — I will own kickoff and cadence.
- Technical lead: Sergio — provisioning, ingest, prompt set, observability dashboards.
- Enablement/customer success: Marissa — onboarding checklist, acceptance criteria walk-through, and weekly health check.

Checklist to own before kickoff (Dec 6):
- Sergio: sandbox org created, ACLs configured, sample ingest job template ready.
- Marissa: acceptance criteria doc and pilot success scorecard created (precision/latency/cost).
- Ben: finalize DocuSign and SOC2 package sent to procurement.

I’ll schedule a 30-min internal sync tomorrow to ensure we’ve got the sandbox + SOW complete. Will share the external kickoff invite once procurement confirms MSA signature.

Thanks —
Rachel

From: James Park <james.park@hillcrest-logistics.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hillcrest-logistics.com>, Marta Li <marta.li@hillcrest-logistics.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 08:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot onramp — Hillcrest Logistics

Team — brief update from procurement: they received the DocuSign link and will process the pilot MSA today. We’re on track to deliver the sanitized CSV and schema by Thursday morning (attached).

We can provide the following for sandbox allowlisting: 52.34.120.0/24 (service egress).

Confirming kickoff: Dec 6 at 10:00 AM PT works for Hillcrest. Can you send a calendar invite with a short agenda (30 minutes)?

One outstanding asks from our side before kickoff: can you confirm definitions for the two main acceptance metrics so we’re aligned? Specifically:
- "Precision on extraction/evidence classification" — what labeling protocol will Redwood use for the holdout?
- "Avg triage time reduction" — are we measuring from ticket open to final classification, or from when a human first touches a ticket?

Attaching: data-sample-schema.csv (sanitized).

Thanks — looking forward.

—
James Park
